description: This Java class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named ScoreResponse for representing a score entry in an API response, including fields such as id, playerName, score, durationMs, createdAt, and rank. It includes constructors, getters, and setters, and uses Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: ScoreResponse
classes.description: A DTO class for API responses representing a score with associated details.
